messages:
tara: Quick idea 3 mini 'Rogue & Deck Jam' this Friday in the mezz. low-key, BYO controller/deck, potluck snacks?

samir: In. i'll bring my docked switch and a stack of indie roguelikes on Steam.

jo: i'll bring a couple of ethernet cables and a USB hub. label please.

niko: count me in if there's a parlay tournament for Risk of Rain or Spelunky.

linda: i'll bake brownies and bring napkins. veg-friendly option too.

poll-bot: POLL by tara 3 "Start time" Options: "6pm", "7pm", "8pm". Votes: Tara (7pm), Samir (7pm), Jo (6pm), Niko (7pm), Linda (7pm).

tara: 7pm it is. i'll book mezzanine and put up a sign.

office-bot: Reminder: mezzanine reserved 7pm-11pm. Please return chairs to stacks and clear the kitchenette area after event.

samir: small rules: one mystery key per person, please no removing office monitors. remote folks can join chat riddle for two keys.

jo: can we run a tiny bracket for local multiplayer? i'll make a sheet.

niko: also bringing a couple of spare controllers and a Steam Link if folks want to stream.

linda: allergy note: brownies contain nuts. i'll label them.

tara: clue plan: hide 4 keys with sticky-note riddles around mezz, winners DM me. remote raffle for two extra keys.

samir: logistics: does anyone have a travel router? last event NATed weirdly.

jo: i have a spare TP-Link travel router and i'll bring a short howto:
```
# travel router basics
set mode=router
enable dhcp
connect wan to ethernet
```

niko: awesome. see y'all Friday partyparrot

linda: i'll add a tiny cleanup sign-up on the sheet.

tara: final note: keep volume reasonable after 10:30 and please clean up spills. see you!
